brief:
# Fix main CI after Pipeline 2.0 (PR #852)

Brett, Nov 19 2026 (voice). PR #852 (Pipeline 2.0) merged to main before CI finished. On main, workflow "Android framework + console" run 44539449204 failed in two jobs. Fix both, nothing else.

1. Build engine sweep (Node), step `node framework/cli/plugins.mjs --check`:
   `apps/console-web/plugins/merge-queue-view/plugin.json: "builtWith.model" is "Opus"; allowed: "fable", "opus", "sonnet"`.
   Lowercase it. Then grep every plugin.json added or changed by #852 for the same mistake (capitalised model names) and fix those too.
2. Web Dev Console (React/TS) + Python API, step "Alerts + MCP client + axf_server: engines match their fixtures (TS, Python), conflict detection, console alert server, web push encryption". Read the full failed log (`gh run view 44539449204 --log-failed`), find the real error, fix the cause. If a fixture is stale because #852 changed a contract on purpose, regenerate the fixture; if #852 broke behaviour, fix the code.
3. Run `node framework/cli/plugins.mjs --check` and that console step locally, then the full workflow's checks you can run here (Node 20 / load failures on this VPS are environment; say which).
4. Push and open ONE PR titled "Fix main CI after Pipeline 2.0". Do NOT merge it; Brett merges only after CI is green. Report in _claude/builds/reports/fix-main-ci-p2.md with both causes in plain words.

steps.text: Gate: confirm Phone Connect is paired and online (systems check item 'phone-connect' green, GET /api/plugins/phone-connect/status paired+online) and CI built phone-connect-debug.apk; stop with a note otherwise.
Remove apps/amberx-droid (Capacitor shell + amberx-web), its project manifest and the AmberX CI job in .github/workflows/android.yml; ci-scope, watch-live and app-bundle entries.
Drop AmberX from framework/schemas/shared-assets.json, re-bake (shared-assets.mjs bake|check), chrome-settings check, check-chrome-assets baseline only down.

Notify routes: notify-control types/channels naming the AmberX app (amberx.* types, app 'amberx'), the phone=True alert feed for AmberX, approvals-banner target amberx-droid; keep channel id 'amberx' as the phone push channel or migrate it with a settings migration.

Plugins and code naming apps/amberx-droid (amberx-listeners, wake-listener, output-recorder, console-commands wake fallback, molly/axhub-web/walkthrough references): remove or point at Phone Connect; plugin-lifecycle check, project validate --all.
Docs and rules mentions (CLAUDE.md, STATUS.md, THREADS, memory docs, RULES.md exceptions naming AmberX); help coverage, tracker.mjs, catalog status.json.
Tests: full CI sweep green, report _claude/builds/reports/remove-amberx-app-code-once-phone.md, PR.

open: UI copy that still says "AmberX phone" where Phone Connect now does the work: console-commands wake, claude-badge phone badge, notify-control types, claude-session recording (`amberx.recorder_*` to `phone.recorder_*`).
The AmberX listeners plugin reads listener rows only the AmberX app published; it shows nothing new until Phone Connect publishes listener@1 rows.
The axHub `amberx` device service (recorder and open-url tools) is axHub's; retire it there once nothing calls the `amberx.*` names.
`apps/console-web/plugins/agent-swarm/test.mjs` fails on the PR branch before this change too ("nothing posts for merge-queue"); it is not in CI.
